findings.text: The list of supported rule phases includes `window`, but the same document (line 96) and ADR 0027 D3 (line 97) say window functions stay unsupported. Fix: remove `window` from the phase list, or say that it is reserved for a future model constructor and accepts no rule now.

The rule attribute adds numeric priorities, local and global registration, and 13 phases. Neither the document nor the status file names a present problem for these beyond the owner's request for extensibility (B08 and B09 only test them). Fix: reduce the attribute to the smallest form that B08 needs, for example a phase name with declaration-name ordering and no priorities. Alternatively, record the owner request that requires priorities and global registration.
